title: Article structural health check ('Python (programming language)')
prompt: Deep structural audit of 'Python (programming language)': infobox, lead paragraphs, section structure, template taxonomy, navboxes, empty sections, and categories. Produce a health report.

expected_output.description: Health report: infobox params, lead length, H2/H3 section counts, template taxonomy breakdown, navbox list, empty-section list, category list.

canaries.name: Navbox diversity
canaries.description: Navboxes use diverse names ({{Portal}}, {{Authority control}}, {{Python sidebar}}) - not just templates containing 'navbox'. The no-skills variant found 0 (should be 2+).
canaries.detection: navbox count == 0 while the wikitext contains Portal bar / Authority control.

canaries.name: Template-only sections are not empty
canaries.description: References/Notes/Further reading contain only template calls ({{Reflist}}, {{Notelist}}) and are NOT empty. The no-skills variant flagged 5 false positives.
canaries.detection: References/Notes/Further reading listed as empty sections.

canaries.name: action=raw key
canaries.description: The wikitext response key is 'content' (not '*'); the no-skills variant burned ~3 min on this.
canaries.detection: KeyError reading the raw wikitext response.

checks.detail: Re-run the canonical audit on the same revision: parse wikitext with mwparserfromhell, count H2/H3, detect navbox-class templates, count categories via API.
checks.pass_condition: Agent's H2/H3 counts and category list match the live recompute; navbox list matches (Authority control / Portal present).

checks.detail: Template-only sections (References, Notes, Further reading) must not be reported empty.
checks.pass_condition: empty_sections does not include References/Notes/Further reading.

checks.detail: Navbox detection must catch non-'navbox'-named templates.
checks.pass_condition: navboxes >= 1 and includes Authority control or Portal bar.

checks.detail: Health report has template taxonomy with >= 4 categories.
checks.pass_condition: Taxonomy breakdown present with >= 4 distinct template classes.

port_notes: AB result: no-skills produced a professional-looking health report with wrong numbers (0 navboxes, 5 false empty sections) - the canonical silent-failure example. Pin the revision for exact v1 comparison; the article is heavily edited.
